messages.subject: Using edit() in ShinyApps
parts:
Dear all,

My application lets the user manually edit a matrix with the command edit(). On ShinyApps this command yields an error:

Error: problem with running editor vi

Is this due to R running in linux and not windows? Is there a work around?

Many Thanks

Marcus

messages.author: 2cc2c22c61b42530
messages.subject: Re: Using edit() in ShinyApps
parts:
Response from Andy:

Marcus,

I wouldn't expect that to work. The edit command is for editing files that are local, not running on a server.

Sorry.
-Andy

Will have to work around this...
